items.title: LiteLLM Python Package With 95 Million Downloads Compromised by TeamPCP Hackers
items.description: A widely used open-source Python library was compromised on the Python Package Index (PyPI). Versions 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 of the package, which route requests across various LLM providers and have over 95 million monthly downloads, were found to contain a sophisticated backdoor by security vendors Endor Labs and JFrog. items.title: FCC Bans New Foreign-Made Routers Over Supply Chain and Cyber Risk Concerns
items.description: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) said on Monday that it was banning the import of new, foreign-made consumer routers, citing "unacceptable" risks to cyber and national security.
